{% if web_static or profile == "web" or profile == "realtime-web" or profile == "saas-web" or profile == "full-reference-web" -%}
ARG OMNIUS_WEB_BASE_PATH=/

FROM node:24.19.0-bookworm-slim AS web-build
ARG OMNIUS_WEB_BASE_PATH
ENV OMNIUS_WEB_BASE_PATH=$OMNIUS_WEB_BASE_PATH
WORKDIR /workspace
RUN npm install --global pnpm@11.23.0
COPY package.json pnpm-lock.yaml pnpm-workspace.yaml ./
COPY packages/web-sdk/package.json packages/web-sdk/package.json
COPY web/package.json web/package.json
RUN pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
COPY . .
RUN pnpm --filter @omnius/web build

{% endif -%}
FROM rust:1.98-bookworm AS build
WORKDIR /workspace
COPY . .
RUN cargo build --release --package {{project-name}}

FROM debian:bookworm-slim
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install --yes --no-install-recommends libssl3 \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
WORKDIR /app
{% if web_static or profile == "web" or profile == "realtime-web" or profile == "saas-web" or profile == "full-reference-web" -%}
ARG OMNIUS_WEB_BASE_PATH
ENV OMNIUS_WEB_BASE_PATH=$OMNIUS_WEB_BASE_PATH
{% endif -%}
COPY --from=build /workspace/target/release/{{project-name}} /usr/local/bin/service
COPY --from=build /workspace/config /app/config
{% if web_static or profile == "web" or profile == "realtime-web" or profile == "saas-web" or profile == "full-reference-web" -%}
COPY --from=web-build /workspace/web/dist /app/web/dist
{% endif -%}
USER 65532:65532
ENV OMNIUS__SERVER__LISTEN_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0:3000
EXPOSE 3000
HEALTHCHECK --interval=10s --timeout=3s --start-period=5s --retries=3 CMD ["service", "healthcheck", "--address", "127.0.0.1:3000"]
ENTRYPOINT ["service"]
CMD ["server"]

schema_version: 1
bundle_version: 0.2.0
profiles:
- id: minimal
  description: No external services
  modules:
  - core
  - config
  - telemetry
  - runtime
  - http
  - health
  - test-support
  - rate-limit-local
  - generator
- id: api
  description: PostgreSQL REST API
  extends: minimal
  modules:
  - postgres
  - migrations
  - validation
  - openapi
  - idempotency
  - outbound-http
- id: authenticated-api
  description: API with local accounts, passwords, PostgreSQL sessions, JWTs, API keys, authorization, audit, and email delivery
  extends: api
  modules:
  - auth-core
  - auth-password
  - auth-session-postgres
  - auth-jwt
  - auth-api-key
  - authz-basic
  - audit
  - email
  - jobs-core
- id: oauth-provider
  description: Authenticated API hosting the first-party OAuth Authorization Server and OpenID Provider
  extends: authenticated-api
  modules:
  - auth-oauth-server
  - tenancy
- id: saas
  description: Multi-tenant SaaS with jobs, storage, notifications, and webhooks
  extends: authenticated-api
  modules:
  - redis-core
  - cache-redis
  - tenancy
  - admin
  - jobs-apalis-redis
  - outbox
  - inbox
  - scheduler
  - object-storage
  - notifications
  - webhooks-svix
  - webhooks-inbound
  - feature-flags
- id: saas-pgmq
  description: SaaS variant using PGMQ instead of Redis jobs
  extends: authenticated-api
  modules:
  - cache-local
  - tenancy
  - admin
  - jobs-pgmq
  - outbox
  - inbox
  - scheduler
  - object-storage
  - notifications
  - webhooks-svix
  - webhooks-inbound
  - feature-flags
- id: realtime
  description: Authenticated realtime service with ephemeral Redis fan-out
  extends: authenticated-api
  modules:
  - redis-core
  - cache-redis
  - events-redis-ephemeral
  - realtime-core

# Generated safe runtime configuration. Secrets are supplied through the process environment.
[idempotency]
enabled = true
max_response_bytes = 65536
ttl = "24h"

[migrations]
operation_timeout = "30s"
run_on_startup = true

[openapi]
docs_route_enabled = true
document_route_enabled = true
max_document_bytes = 4194304

[outbound_http]
connect_timeout = "5s"
max_redirects = 5
response_body_limit_bytes = 2097152
total_timeout = "30s"
user_agent = "{{project-name}}/0.1.0"

[outbound_http.proxy]
mode = "disabled"

[outbound_http.url_policy]
allow_development_loopback_http = false
allowed_https_ports = [443]
deny_cidrs = []
dns_timeout = "2s"
max_dns_answers = 32

[pagination]

[postgres]
acquire_timeout = "5s"
application_name = "{{project-name}}"
connect_timeout = "10s"
health_timeout = "5s"
idle_timeout = "5m"
initialization_sql = []
lock_timeout = "1s"
max_connections = 16
max_lifetime = "30m"
max_lifetime_jitter = "5m"
min_connections = 1
shutdown_timeout = "5s"
statement_timeout = "5s"
tls_mode = "disable"

[postgres.transaction_retry]
base_delay = "10ms"
isolation = "serializable"
max_attempts = 3
max_delay = "100ms"
max_jitter = "10ms"

[telemetry]
environment = "development"
filter = "info"
format = "pretty"
prometheus = false
service = "{{project-name}}"
version = "0.1.0"

vite = "8.2.2"
tanstack_query = "5.102.2"

zod = "4.4.3"
zustand = "5.0.15"

[generation]
orval = "8.26.0"
orval_policy = "Exact pin; trusted local OpenAPI only; isolated secret-free generation; disable unused mock/MCP/Zod output; advisory gate and adapter boundary."

asyncapi_version = "3.1.0"

vitest = "4.1.11"
testing_library_react = "16.3.2"

[tooling_policy]
lockfile = "pnpm-lock.yaml committed; frozen install in CI."
package_manager_field = "packageManager must name the exact pnpm version."
dependency_updates = "Automated PRs are allowed but code generators and major runtime changes require explicit review."
lifecycle_scripts = "Do not permit an unrestricted lifecycle-script allowlist."
source_maps = "Private or disabled by default in production."
browser_matrix = "Current Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit; exact versions are CI image outputs."

[compatibility_gates]
typescript_7 = "Adopt only after Orval, generated declarations, Vite, Vitest, editor tooling, and any programmatic compiler consumers pass."
orval_upgrade = "Treat every upgrade as code-generation supply-chain work; review advisories and generated diff."
msw_source = "Use only after generation fidelity, error responses, and package compatibility pass."
ssr = "Out of baseline; requires a new ADR and profile."
component_library = "Unselected; product/design-system decision."

FROM rust:1.98-bookworm AS build
WORKDIR /workspace
COPY . .
RUN cargo build --release --package {{project-name}}

FROM debian:bookworm-slim
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install --yes --no-install-recommends libssl3 \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=build /workspace/target/release/{{project-name}} /usr/local/bin/service
COPY --from=build /workspace/config /app/config
USER 65532:65532
ENV OMNIUS__SERVER__LISTEN_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0:3000
EXPOSE 3000
HEALTHCHECK --interval=10s --timeout=3s --start-period=5s --retries=3 CMD ["service", "healthcheck", "--address", "127.0.0.1:3000"]
ENTRYPOINT ["service"]
CMD ["server"]

6913d941cf9762290d9dcc9cf2c3085fdbe5729c.text:
schema_version: 1.0.0
extension_version: 0.1.0
base_bundle_version: 0.1.0
risks:
- id: R-WEB-001
  risk: Contract drift
  trigger: Frontend generated output is not regenerated after Rust contract changes
  impact: High
  likelihood: Medium
  mitigation: Deterministic contracts check and generated-output diff gate
  owner: Platform
- id: R-WEB-002
  risk: Unstable public identifiers
  trigger: Operation, permission, event, or capability IDs are renamed casually
  impact: High
  likelihood: Medium
  mitigation: Semantic diff, deprecation policy, ADR for breaking changes
  owner: API
- id: R-WEB-003
  risk: Generated-code supply-chain execution
  trigger: Code generator processes a malicious or remote OpenAPI document
  impact: Critical
  likelihood: Low
  mitigation: Trusted local input only, exact pin, isolated secret-free generation
  owner: Security
- id: R-WEB-004
  risk: Generator dependency advisory
  trigger: A code-generation dependency receives a code-execution advisory
  impact: Critical
  likelihood: Medium
  mitigation: Advisory gate, update review, adapter boundary, blocked release
  owner: Security
- id: R-WEB-005
  risk: TypeScript 7 tool incompatibility
  trigger: Native compiler lacks an API or behavior used by generator/tooling
  impact: Medium
  likelihood: Medium
  mitigation: Initial TS 6.0.2 baseline and explicit TS7 compatibility gate
  owner: Frontend
- id: R-WEB-006
  risk: Server-state duplication
  trigger: Product developers mirror API data into Zustand
  impact: High
  likelihood: High
  mitigation: State ownership ADR, lint/review rules, Query key utilities
  owner: Frontend
- id: R-WEB-007
  risk: Client authorization treated as security
  trigger: UI guards are mistaken for backend enforcement
  impact: Critical
  likelihood: Medium
  mitigation: Direct API negative tests and explicit documentation
  owner: Security
- id: R-WEB-008
  risk: Session credential exposure
  trigger: Session or bearer credential reaches JS-visible storage/logs
  impact: Critical
  likelihood: Low
  mitigation: HttpOnly session default, storage scan, redacted telemetry tests
  owner: Identity
- id: R-WEB-009
  risk: CSRF regression
  trigger: Cookie-authenticated unsafe requests bypass approved origin/token controls
  impact: Critical
  likelihood: Medium
  mitigation: CSRF negative matrix and same-origin proxy defaults
  owner: Security
- id: R-WEB-010
  risk: Tenant cache bleed
  trigger: Query or local state is reused across tenant changes
  impact: Critical
  likelihood: Medium
  mitigation: Tenant-scoped keys, cancellation/reset lifecycle, E2E fixture
  owner: Tenancy
- id: R-WEB-011
  risk: Realtime reconnect storm
  trigger: Auth/server failures trigger unbounded reconnects
  impact: High
  likelihood: Medium
  mitigation: Bounded jitter, terminal auth state, fake-clock tests
  owner: Realtime
- id: R-WEB-012
  risk: Realtime stale patch
  trigger: Partial or out-of-order event overwrites newer HTTP cache state
  impact: High
  likelihood: Medium
  mitigation: Invalidate by default; validated versioned complete patch only
  owner: Realtime
- id: R-WEB-013
  risk: Missed event misunderstanding
  trigger: Ephemeral transport is treated as durable source of truth
  impact: High
  likelihood: Medium
  mitigation: Explicit resume/revalidation semantics and HTTP reconstruction
  owner: Realtime
- id: R-WEB-014
  risk: SPA fallback masks backend errors
  trigger: Fallback returns HTML for API or transport 404s
  impact: High
  likelihood: Medium
  mitigation: Reserved namespaces and negative route tests
  owner: HTTP
- id: R-WEB-015
  risk: Incorrect asset caching
  trigger: Application shell or non-fingerprinted assets become immutable
  impact: High
  likelihood: Medium
  mitigation: Cache-class tests and manifest-based serving
  owner: Operations
- id: R-WEB-016
  risk: Weak CSP in production
  trigger: Development HMR allowances leak into production policy
  impact: High
  likelihood: Medium
  mitigation: Separate configs and production header tests
  owner: Security
- id: R-WEB-017
  risk: Source-map disclosure
  trigger: Production source maps expose internal source unexpectedly
  impact: Medium
  likelihood: Medium
  mitigation: Private/disabled default and release check
  owner: Security
- id: R-WEB-018
  risk: Secrets bundled by Vite
  trigger: Server secret is exposed through public environment variables
  impact: Critical
  likelihood: Low
  mitigation: Explicit public config schema, bundle scans, build-secret handling
  owner: Security
- id: R-WEB-019
  risk: Upload authorization gap
  trigger: Signed URL or completion path bypasses ownership and scan state
  impact: Critical
  likelihood: Medium
  mitigation: Authorize initiation/completion, quarantine state, E2E negative tests
  owner: Storage
- id: R-WEB-020
  risk: Mock fidelity gap
  trigger: Generated MSW handlers create states the real backend cannot produce
  impact: Medium
  likelihood: High
  mitigation: Actual-backend Playwright suite and constrained fixture builders
  owner: Quality
- id: R-WEB-021
  risk: Accessibility false confidence
  trigger: Automated checks pass while keyboard/screen-reader paths fail
  impact: High
  likelihood: Medium
  mitigation: Manual release checklist plus automated representative routes
  owner: Accessibility
- id: R-WEB-022
  risk: Bundle growth
  trigger: SDK imports every capability and route into initial bundle
  impact: Medium
  likelihood: High
  mitigation: Subpath exports, route splitting, bundle budgets
  owner: Performance
- id: R-WEB-023
  risk: Generator overwrites product UI
  trigger: Add/upgrade rewrites application-owned files
  impact: Critical
  likelihood: Low
  mitigation: Ownership model, managed regions, collision abort, upgrade fixtures
  owner: Generator
- id: R-WEB-024
  risk: Frontend/backend version skew
  trigger: Separately deployed assets call an incompatible backend
  impact: High
  likelihood: Medium
  mitigation: Embedded contract hash, runtime metadata, compatibility window
  owner: Operations
- id: R-WEB-025
  risk: TanStack Router declaration-family regression
  trigger: Router packages are upgraded to a family that fails strict TypeScript declaration checking
  impact: High
  likelihood: Medium
  mitigation: ADR 0032 exact family pins plus TS6, TS7, generated-output, and browser gates
  owner: Frontend

schema_version: 1
bundle_version: 0.2.0
runtime_dependencies:
- kind: compose
  id: postgresql
  service: postgres
  image: postgres@sha256:ef257d85f76e48da1c64832459b59fcaba1a4dac97bf5d7450c77753542eee94
  volume: postgres-data
  volume_mount: /var/lib/postgresql/data
  healthcheck:
    test:
    - CMD-SHELL
    - pg_isready -U omnius -d omnius
    interval: 2s
    timeout: 5s
    retries: 30
  service_environment:
  - name: POSTGRES_DB
    value: omnius
  - name: POSTGRES_USER
    value: omnius
  - name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
    value: omnius-development-only
    secret: true
    development_only: true
  - name: POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS
    value: --auth-host=scram-sha-256
  application_environment:
  - name: OMNIUS__POSTGRES__URL
    value: postgres://omnius:omnius-development-only@postgres:5432/omnius
    secret: true
    development_only: true
  - name: OMNIUS__PAGINATION__CURSOR_SIGNING_KEY
    value: omnius-compose-development-key!!
    secret: true
    development_only: true
  - name: OMNIUS__MIGRATIONS__RUN_ON_STARTUP
    value: 'false'
    development_only: true
  migration:
    required_module: migrations
    command:
    - migrate
- kind: external
  id: redis-or-valkey
  bindings:
  - name: OMNIUS__REDIS__URL
    message: set the Redis or Valkey endpoint
    credential: false
- kind: external
  id: oidc-provider
  bindings:
  - name: OMNIUS__AUTH_OIDC__ISSUER_URL
    message: set the OIDC issuer URL
    credential: false
  - name: OMNIUS__AUTH_OIDC__CLIENT_ID
    message: set the OIDC client ID
    credential: true
  - name: OMNIUS__AUTH_OIDC__CLIENT_SECRET
    message: set the OIDC client secret
    credential: true

    credential: true
- kind: external
  id: object-store

  - name: OMNIUS__OBJECT_STORAGE__ENDPOINT
    message: set the object storage endpoint
    credential: false
  - name: OMNIUS__OBJECT_STORAGE__ACCESS_KEY_ID
    message: set the object storage access key ID
    credential: true
  - name: OMNIUS__OBJECT_STORAGE__SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
    message: set the object storage secret access key
    credential: true
- kind: external
  id: smtp-or-email-provider
  bindings:
  - name: OMNIUS__EMAIL__SMTP_URL
    message: set the SMTP or email provider endpoint
    credential: false
  - name: OMNIUS__EMAIL__USERNAME
    message: set the email provider username
    credential: true
  - name: OMNIUS__EMAIL__PASSWORD
    message: set the email provider password
    credential: true
- kind: external
  id: svix
  bindings:
  - name: OMNIUS__WEBHOOKS_SVIX__ENDPOINT
    message: set the Svix endpoint
    credential: false
  - name: OMNIUS__WEBHOOKS_SVIX__TOKEN
    message: set the Svix token
    credential: true
- kind: external
  id: flag-provider

  - name: OMNIUS__FEATURE_FLAGS__API_KEY

9305e6d08dbfb95169c193e8f466b8d8f4bd24b6.text:
schema_version: 1.0.0
extension: llm-mcp-suite
version: 0.1.0
requires:
- id: omnius-specs
  version: 0.1.0
- id: web-application-suite
  version: 0.1.0
operations:
- source: machine/extensions/llm-mcp-suite/module-catalog.yaml
  target: machine/module-catalog.yaml
  collection: modules
  unique_key: id
- source: machine/extensions/llm-mcp-suite/module-catalog.yaml
  target: machine/module-catalog.yaml
  collection: runtime_dependencies
  unique_key: id
- source: machine/extensions/llm-mcp-suite/profiles.yaml
  target: machine/profiles.yaml
  collection: profiles
  unique_key: id
- source: machine/extensions/llm-mcp-suite/acceptance-criteria.yaml
  target: machine/acceptance-criteria.yaml
  collection: criteria
  unique_key: id
- source: machine/extensions/llm-mcp-suite/tasks.yaml
  target: machine/tasks.yaml
  collection: tasks
  unique_key: id
- source: machine/extensions/llm-mcp-suite/risk-register.yaml
  target: machine/risk-register.yaml
  collection: risks
  unique_key: id
- source: machine/extensions/llm-mcp-suite/recommendation-traceability.csv
  target: machine/recommendation-traceability.csv
  unique_key: recommendation_id
independent_catalogs:
- machine/extensions/llm-mcp-suite/frontend-capabilities.yaml
- machine/extensions/llm-mcp-suite/dependency-baseline.toml
- machine/extensions/llm-mcp-suite/llm-capabilities.yaml
- machine/extensions/llm-mcp-suite/provider-catalog.yaml
- machine/extensions/llm-mcp-suite/mcp-exposure-catalog.yaml
- machine/extensions/llm-mcp-suite/mcp-extension-registry.yaml
- machine/extensions/llm-mcp-suite/protocol-compatibility.yaml
post_merge_checks:
- all IDs unique
- base web and AI extension manifests have no path collisions
- module and profile JSON Schema validation
- module dependency closure
- profile inheritance conflicts and provider slots
- task dependency acyclicity
- every AI criterion covered by a task and recommendation
- frontend exposure coverage for all base web and AI modules
- LLM and MCP examples validate
- current MCP baseline and deprecation guard
- manifest hash verification
rollback:
  catalog_entries: remove only entries recorded in the applied marker
  source_files: retain specification documents unless explicitly uninstalling the suite
  application_files: never delete application-owned files automatically
  persisted_data: retain released migrations and data and emit a manual cleanup plan

# {{project-name}}

Generated Omnius service using the `{{ profile }}` base profile.

## Run locally

The checked-in base configuration binds only to loopback. The process automatically
loads the selected `config/reference.toml` overlay:

```console
cargo run -p {{project-name}} -- server
```

Override the reference layer with `--environment-config` or the listener with
`OMNIUS__SERVER__LISTEN_ADDRESS`. Persisted profiles require
`OMNIUS__POSTGRES__URL` and an exact 32-byte
`OMNIUS__PAGINATION__CURSOR_SIGNING_KEY`; neither is written to the overlay.
TOML `${...}` strings are literal and do not read process variables. Inspect the
resolved profile without starting a listener:

```console
cargo run -p {{project-name}} -- profile-info
```

The public base surface is:

- `GET /live`, `GET /ready`, and `GET /startup` for orchestration probes.
- `GET /version` for build, kit, profile, module, and schema metadata.
- `GET /example` for application-owned example behavior.

The exact profile and ordered module versions are recorded in
`.omnius/service.toml`. `apps/service/src/application.rs` and this README are
application-owned; an identical generator pass never overwrites them.

Selected advanced modules may still require external endpoint/credential
bindings and named application-owned runtime traits. They fail closed until
supplied; a declared router or task is not a substitute for those contracts.

## Application extension

Keep the generated `application::contributions(ApplicationContributions) ->
ApplicationContributions` entry point and attach a custom HTTP application with
`with_application_extension`. Its one-shot factory runs after the selected
runtime has been connected and receives `ApplicationRuntime`, whose
`postgres_pool()` and `idempotency_store()` methods clone the already-selected
handles without opening another connection or performing I/O. The
`service_kit::postgres`, `service_kit::idempotency`,
`service_kit::migrations`, and `service_kit::test_support` facades expose the
selected provider APIs without adding competing dependency versions.

Return `ApplicationExtension::new(router, routes, openapi_document, operations)`
with the custom router, route IDs, complete OpenAPI document, and operation
descriptors. When installed, those contracts replace
the generated `/example` and `/reference-records` scaffold routes.

## Schema compatibility and PostgreSQL

Profiles with migrations use the kit's schema bounds by default. A generated
application with migrations in the reserved range
`9000000000000000000..=9099999999999999999` may add
`migrations/application-compatibility.toml`:

```toml
schema_version = 1
minimum = "9000000000000000000"
maximum = "9000000000000000000"
```

The file is strict: the bounds are quoted positive integer strings, ordered,
and both inside the reserved range. The same compiled bounds govern server
startup, `migrate`, `migration-status`, and reported build metadata. Application
SQL files remain part of the one shared SQLx migration history.

For PostgreSQL profiles, `ops/compose.yaml` owns one local-development
PostgreSQL service and a single one-shot migration service. Production
PostgreSQL is operator-provided. Configure the generated application to use
that compatible external service rather than treating the local Compose
container as a production database.

See `docs/operations.md` for container and release metadata guidance.

b6e4a532f915fac250d449dc0db5e1b7de7c2c68.text:
[workspace]
resolver = "3"
members = [
  "apps/service",
  "crates/service-kit",
  # omnius:managed-begin id=workspace-members version=1 hash=e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855
  # omnius:managed-end id=workspace-members
]

[workspace.package]
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.98.0"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"

[workspace.dependencies]
axum = { version = "=0.8.9", features = ["json", "query", "ws", "multipart"] }
clap = { version = "=4.6.6", features = ["derive"] }
garde = { version = "=0.23.0", features = ["derive"] }
humantime-serde = "=1.1.1"
http-body-util = "=0.1.3"
serde = { version = "=1.0.229", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "=1.0.151"
time = { version = "=0.3.55", features = ["serde", "formatting", "parsing"] }
tokio = { version = "=1.53.1", features = ["fs", "io-util", "macros", "net", "process", "rt-multi-thread", "signal", "sync", "time"] }
thiserror = "=2.0.20"
toml = "=1.1.4"
tower = { version = "=0.5.3", features = ["util", "timeout", "limit", "load-shed", "retry", "buffer"] }
tracing = "=0.1.44"
# omnius:managed-begin id=workspace-dependencies version=1 hash=e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855
# omnius:managed-end id=workspace-dependencies

[workspace.lints.rust]
unsafe_code = "forbid"
rust_2024_compatibility = { level = "deny", priority = -1 }

[workspace.lints.clippy]
all = { level = "deny", priority = -1 }
pedantic = { level = "warn", priority = -1 }
unwrap_used = "deny"
expect_used = "warn"

cbbc6d0b63b6de841521e57ea7e477741ab72429.text:
schema_version: 1.0.0
extension:
  id: web-application-suite
  version: 0.1.0
  requires_bundle: 0.1.0
  applied_marker: machine/applied-extensions/web-application-suite-0.1.0.json
strategy:
  preferred: overlay
  alternative: deterministic_append
  idempotency_key: web-application-suite@0.1.0
  collision_policy: fail
  preserve_existing_order: true
  sort_new_entries_by_id: true
catalogs:
- source: machine/extensions/web-application-suite/module-catalog.yaml
  source_key: modules
  target: machine/module-catalog.yaml
  target_key: modules
  unique_key: id
- source: machine/extensions/web-application-suite/profiles.yaml
  source_key: profiles
  target: machine/profiles.yaml
  target_key: profiles
  unique_key: id
- source: machine/extensions/web-application-suite/acceptance-criteria.yaml
  source_key: criteria
  target: machine/acceptance-criteria.yaml
  target_key: criteria
  unique_key: id
- source: machine/extensions/web-application-suite/tasks.yaml
  source_key: tasks
  target: machine/tasks.yaml
  target_key: tasks
  unique_key: id
- source: machine/extensions/web-application-suite/risk-register.yaml
  source_key: risks
  target: machine/risk-register.yaml
  target_key: risks
  unique_key: id
csv_catalogs:
- source: machine/extensions/web-application-suite/recommendation-traceability.csv
  target: machine/recommendation-traceability.csv
  unique_key: recommendation_id
independent_catalogs:
- machine/extensions/web-application-suite/frontend-capabilities.yaml
- machine/extensions/web-application-suite/dependency-baseline.toml
post_merge_checks:
- all IDs unique
- module and profile JSON Schema validation
- module dependency closure
- profile inheritance and conflicts
- task dependency acyclicity
- acceptance and recommendation references
- frontend exposure coverage for every base and extension module
- extension path collision check
- manifest hash verification
rollback:
  catalog_entries: remove only entries recorded in the applied marker
  source_files: retain extension documents unless explicitly uninstalling the specification
    suite
  application_files: never delete application-owned files automatically

e462e9110a88eaf88a9af8488018a514dd506fd6.text:
# Short-link service

This is an independent generated Omnius workspace containing a PostgreSQL-backed
short-link API. Run the service commands below from
`examples/{{project-name}}`.

## Prerequisites

- Docker Engine with Docker Compose v2 (`docker compose`).
- `curl` and `jq` for the API walkthrough.
- Rust 1.98 or newer and Cargo for the repository-root generator checks.

Compose supplies PostgreSQL for local development. In production, configure the
application to use any compatible operator-provided external PostgreSQL service;
the Compose database is not a production dependency.

## Start the service

```console
docker compose -f ops/compose.yaml up --build --wait
```

Compose starts PostgreSQL, runs the one-shot `migrate` service, and exposes the
application only on `http://127.0.0.1:3000`.

```console
BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3000
```

## Exercise the API

### Create a short link

`POST /links` requires exactly one `Idempotency-Key`, an
`application/json` content type, and the strict JSON shape shown below. `url` is
the only accepted field.

```console
CREATE_BODY="$(mktemp)"
curl --silent --show-error \
  --request POST \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --header 'Idempotency-Key: docs-create-1' \
  --data '{"url":"https://example.com/docs?a=1"}' \
  --output "$CREATE_BODY" \
  --write-out 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' \
  "$BASE_URL/links"
jq . "$CREATE_BODY"
CODE="$(jq -r .code "$CREATE_BODY")"
```

The response is `201 Created` with a newly generated 12-character lowercase-hex
code; the exact code varies:

```text
HTTP 201
{
  "code": "<generated-code>",
  "url": "https://example.com/docs?a=1",
  "redirect_path": "/r/<generated-code>"
}
```

### Replay the request

Repeating the same key and JSON returns the exact stored status, content type,
and body. The final command confirms that the bodies are byte-identical.

```console
REPLAY_BODY="$(mktemp)"
curl --silent --show-error \
  --request POST \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --header 'Idempotency-Key: docs-create-1' \
  --data '{"url":"https://example.com/docs?a=1"}' \
  --output "$REPLAY_BODY" \
  --write-out 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' \
  "$BASE_URL/links"
cmp "$CREATE_BODY" "$REPLAY_BODY" && echo 'Replay body is byte-identical'
```

Expected: `HTTP 201` and `Replay body is byte-identical`.

### Reuse the key with a different request

```console
curl --include --silent --show-error \
  --request POST \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --header 'Idempotency-Key: docs-create-1' \
  --data '{"url":"https://example.org/changed"}' \
  "$BASE_URL/links"
```

Expected: `409 Conflict`, content type `application/problem+json`, and a body
like this (the request ID varies):

```json
{
  "type": "https://errors.omnius.invalid/idempotency_conflict",
  "title": "Conflict",
  "status": 409,
  "code": "IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT",
  "request_id": "<generated-request-id>",
  "detail": "Idempotency-Key was already used for a different request"
}
```

### List and resolve the link

```console
curl --silent --show-error "$BASE_URL/links" | jq .
curl --include --silent --show-error "$BASE_URL/r/$CODE"
```

`GET /links` returns `200 OK` and includes the live row:

```json
{
  "links": [
    {
      "code": "<generated-code>",
      "url": "https://example.com/docs?a=1",
      "expired": false
    }
  ]
}
```

`GET /r/$CODE` returns `307 Temporary Redirect` with
`Location: https://example.com/docs?a=1`. The command does not follow the
redirect, so its headers remain visible.

### Expire the link twice, then resolve it again

```console
curl --silent --show-error --request DELETE \
  --output /dev/null --write-out 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' \
  "$BASE_URL/links/$CODE"
curl --silent --show-error --request DELETE \
  --output /dev/null --write-out 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' \
  "$BASE_URL/links/$CODE"
curl --include --silent --show-error "$BASE_URL/r/$CODE"
```

Both `DELETE /links/$CODE` requests return `204 No Content`. Resolution after
expiry returns `404 Not Found` with `application/problem+json` and a body like:

```json
{
  "type": "https://errors.omnius.invalid/short_link_not_found",
  "title": "Not Found",
  "status": 404,
  "code": "SHORT_LINK_NOT_FOUND",
  "request_id": "<generated-request-id>",
  "detail": "short link was not found"
}
```

The complete OpenAPI 3 document is available at:

```text
http://127.0.0.1:3000/openapi.json
```

## Migrations

The startup command already runs the generated one-shot `migrate` service. To
run the application CLI's `migrate` and `migration-status` commands explicitly
through the same Compose image, configuration, and PostgreSQL network:

```console
docker compose -f ops/compose.yaml run --rm migrate
docker compose -f ops/compose.yaml run --rm migrate migration-status
```

## Shut down

The `-v` flag also removes the local PostgreSQL volume.

```console
rm -f "$CREATE_BODY" "$REPLAY_BODY"
docker compose -f ops/compose.yaml down -v
```

## Check generator ownership

From the repository root (not from this example workspace), check that generated
files remain canonical while application-owned files remain independent:

```console
cargo xtask service doctor --project examples/{{project-name}} --json
cargo xtask service diff --project examples/{{project-name}} --json
```

# Operations

## Configuration

`config/base.toml` contains only safe process defaults, and the generated process
loads `config/reference.toml` as its selected runtime overlay. Use `--config` or
`--environment-config` to select different files. Hierarchical process variables
override both layers; use `OMNIUS__SERVER__LISTEN_ADDRESS` for the listener.
Persisted profiles require `OMNIUS__POSTGRES__URL` and an exact 32-byte
`OMNIUS__PAGINATION__CURSOR_SIGNING_KEY`. These secrets are never stored in the
reference overlay. TOML `${...}` strings are literal and do not read process
variables. Containers run from `/app`, load `/app/config`, and bind
`0.0.0.0:3000`; keep the loopback-published deployment boundary.

## Probes and metadata

Use `/live` for process liveness, `/startup` for startup completion, and
`/ready` for traffic readiness. `/version` and the `profile-info` executable
mode return the same non-secret build and composition fields. Release builds
may set `OMNIUS_GIT_REVISION` to 7–64 hexadecimal characters and `OMNIUS_BUILD_TIME`
to an RFC 3339 timestamp.

## Container

Build from the project root with `ops/Dockerfile`. Manager-derived
`ops/compose.yaml` always publishes only `127.0.0.1:3000:3000`. The minimal
topology contains only `app`. Persisted profiles add the repository's
digest-pinned `postgres` service and retained `postgres-data` named volume.
Their one-shot `migrate` service is the sole Compose migration owner; `app`
waits for database health and successful migration, and Compose sets
`OMNIUS__MIGRATIONS__RUN_ON_STARTUP=false`. Normal stop/start retains the named
volume and migration history. Direct/operator launches retain the selected
startup policy and explicit `migrate` / `migration-status` commands instead.
The image runs as an unprivileged numeric user and uses the executable's
bounded readiness check.

Dependencies without a repository-owned pinned, health-checked topology are
external. Compose uses required `${NAME:?message}` YAML bindings for their exact
endpoint and credential variables and does not generate substitute containers.
This is Compose validation syntax, not TOML interpolation. Application-owned
policy, handler, registry, and provider traits also remain fail-closed
prerequisites; router and task outputs do not satisfy them. See
`docs/module-catalog.md` for the selected dependency requirements.

When `web-static` is selected, pass the public router and asset base at build
time, for example `--build-arg OMNIUS_WEB_BASE_PATH=/console`. The locked
frontend build and the runtime static server use that same value. Do not
override `OMNIUS_WEB_BASE_PATH` at runtime with a path different from the one
baked into the frontend assets.
